name: Khmelnytskyi

routes.outcome: Official Khmelnytskyi City Council geoportal identified; it labels the municipal land cadastre as an available register.
Official public cadastral map loaded and advertised city cadastral division, parcel search, and the land-parcel map.

Official dataset card identifies non-agricultural land parcels within the territorial community, provides JSON/API links, and names the Khmelnytskyi City Council Land Resources Department as custodian.

Current HTML/config inspected. The map advertised EPSG:3857 display, SRID list [4326,900992,900919,3857,5561], city map bounds [26.791535,49.301845]-[27.205984,49.510944], and enabled cadastral layers including a national WMS-backed cadastral layer. No vector parcel feature response was returned by the page itself.

Bounded anonymous API response returned 3 of 184 tabular dataset rows. Safe observation: stable-looking pna_id values and administrative parcel-record fields were present, but no geometry was present. Unsafe owner/address/title-related fields were not retained.
Bounded-by-endpoint default response returned 10 of 184 tabular rows and exposed the dataset schema; no geometry field was present. Full raw response remains only in ignored scratch evidence.
Anonymous suggestion endpoint returned public address-search suggestions with coordinates; this is address-search evidence, not parcel geometry, and no suggestion records were retained.

Official map code exposed this cadastral proxy route. A bounded request using a cadastral number cited in an official regional document returned server error; no geometry or parcel identity response was obtained.

National official cadastral map was not used for geometry extraction in this attempt; no local city geometry response was obtained from it. Any availability limitation would not establish citywide absence.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: No parcel geometry response obtained. Viewer advertises EPSG:3857 display and SRIDs 4326, 900992, 900919, 3857, and 5561; no reprojection performed.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: The dataset schema exposed pna_id values, but because no geometry was returned and the field's parcel-identity semantics were not independently verified, no identity was retained as a sample.

sourceFieldMapping.pna_id: candidate native parcel-record identifier; not retained as a sample identity
sourceFieldMapping.geometry: not present in bounded API response

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: one public dataset API request limited to three rows plus one default response

localCustodianAssessment: The Khmelnytskyi City Council geoportal and its Land Resources Department dataset are direct local-service evidence. The StateGeoCadastre / land.gov.ua material is national agency evidence and is kept distinct from the local custodian.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identity if independently evidenced
polygon geometry if returned by the source

qualification.reason: A real local public cadastral service and API are evidenced, but the bounded API response is tabular and the cadastral geometry proxy failed with HTTP 500. No safely verified ID-plus-geometry sample exists.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted.
The API dataset is described as non-agricultural parcels within the territorial community and should not be treated as complete citywide cadastral coverage.
No full parcel polygons are retained because no safely verified parcel geometry response was obtained.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or personal fields were requested for research use or retained in the packet.
A zero geometry response, proxy error, or endpoint limitation is not evidence of citywide absence.
Packet completion does not mean source integration, admission, or runtime readiness.
uncertainty: Local registry custody, public map existence, dataset publication, and anonymous tabular API access are verified. Current public geometry endpoint behavior, exact parcel schema semantics, coverage beyond the non-agricultural dataset, and update/vintage details remain unresolved.
